storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP 123Movies Downloader is the easiest way to download videos from 123Movies and all its mirror sites.

How it works: Navigate to any 123Movies page, press play on a video, then click the extension icon. The extension automatically detects the video stream, shows you available quality options, and downloads it as an MP4 file directly to your computer.

The extension handles HLS streaming conversion automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge needed. It works across all 123Movies mirrors and domain variants.

Key features:
- Automatically detects video playback on any 123Movies mirror
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Choose your preferred quality (720p, 480p, etc.)
- In-page download manager with real-time progress tracking
- Works on all 123Movies domain variants and mirrors
- Dark-themed UI that matches the viewing experience
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to any 123Movies site and play a video
3. Click the extension icon in your toolbar
4. Select quality and click Download

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: Which 123Movies sites does this work on?
faq.answer: It works on all 123Movies mirrors and variants — any domain containing "123movies" or "123-movies" is automatically detected.

faq.question: What format are the downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Do I need to press play first?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension detects the video stream when you start playback. Press play, then click the extension icon.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: You get 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. After that, you can upgrade for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — SERP 123Movies Downloader supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension detecting my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you've pressed play on the video first. Some sites require playback to start before the stream can be captured. If the issue persists, try refreshing the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: The extension only processes video data locally in your browser. Authentication uses a secure OTP (one-time password) system — no passwords are stored.
